#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page (title + current date) to report.pdf using the pdf skill toolchain."""
import datetime
import pathlib
import sys

from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

cwd = pathlib.Path.cwd()
print("Working directory:", cwd)

pdf_files = sorted(cwd.glob("*.pdf")) + sorted(cwd.glob("**/*.pdf"))
print("PDF files found:")
for p in pdf_files:
    print(" -", p)

# Locate report.pdf (case-insensitive)
report_path = None
for p in pdf_files:
    if p.name.lower() == "report.pdf":
        report_path = p
        break
if report_path is None:
    print("ERROR: report.pdf not found in workspace", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)
print("Using report:", report_path)

cover_path = cwd / "cover_page.pdf"
output_path = cwd / "report_with_cover.pdf"

# 1) Build the cover page with reportlab
width, height = letter
c = canvas.Canvas(str(cover_path), pagesize=letter)
c.setFillColorRGB(0, 0, 0)
c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 30)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2.0, height - 280, "Annual Financial Report")
c.setStrokeColorRGB(0, 0, 0)
c.setLineWidth(1.5)
c.line(150, height - 300, width - 150, height - 300)
date_str = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
c.setFont("Helvetica", 18)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2.0, height - 340, date_str)
c.save()
print("Cover page written:", cover_path, "| date:", date_str)

# 2) Prepend the cover page to report.pdf
writer = PdfWriter()
cover_reader = PdfReader(str(cover_path))
writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
reader = PdfReader(str(report_path))
for page in reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

with open(output_path, "wb") as fh:
    writer.write(fh)
with open(report_path, "wb") as fh:  # update report.pdf in place as requested
    writer.write(fh)
print("Merged output written:", output_path, "and", report_path, "| total pages:", 1 + len(reader.pages))

# 3) Validate
check = PdfReader(str(output_path))
first_text = (check.pages[0].extract_text() or "").replace("\n", " | ")
print("Page 1 text:", first_text)
assert "Annual Financial Report" in first_text, "Cover title missing from page 1"
assert date_str in first_text, "Date missing from page 1"
print("VALIDATION OK")

import datetime
import pathlib
import sys

# --- PDF library detection ---
PDF_LIB = None
try:
    from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

    try:

print("PDF files found:")
for p in pdf_files:
    print(" -", p)

report_path = None
for p in pdf_files:
    if p.name.lower() == "report.pdf":
        report_path = p
        break
if report_path is None:
    print("ERROR: report.pdf not found in workspace", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)
print("Using report:", report_path)


def approx_text_width(text, size):
    """Rough Helvetica width estimate (0.55 em per char)."""
    return size * 0.55 * len(text)


def build_cover_pdf(path, title, date_str):
    """Write a minimal single-page PDF with centered title and date."""
    media_w, media_h = 612, 792
    title_size = 30
    date_size = 18
    title_x = max(20.0, (media_w - approx_text_width(title, title_size)) / 2.0)
    date_x = max(20.0, (media_w - approx_text_width(date_str, date_size)) / 2.0)
    # split text into chunks so each line is centered; title/date are single lines here
    content = (
        "BT\n"
        f"/F1 {title_size} Tf\n"
        f"{title_x:.2f} 460 Td\n"
        f"({title}) Tj\n"
        "ET\n"
        "BT\n"
        f"/F2 {date_size} Tf\n"
        f"{date_x:.2f} 415 Td\n"
        f"({date_str}) Tj\n"
        "ET\n"
    ).encode("latin-1")

    objects = {
        1: b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
        2: b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>",
        3: (
            f"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 {media_w} {media_h}] "
            b"/Contents 4 0 R /Resources << /Font << /F1 5 0 R /F2 6 0 R >> >> >>"
        ),
        4: b"<< /Length " + str(len(content)).encode() + b" >>\nstream\n" + content + b"\nendstream",
        5: b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold >>",
        6: b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>",
    }

    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
    offsets = {}
    for num in sorted(objects):
        offsets[num] = len(out)
        out += f"{num} 0 obj\n".encode() + objects[num] + b"\nendobj\n"
    xref_pos = len(out)
    count = max(objects) + 1
    out += f"xref\n0 {count}\n".encode()
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for i in range(1, count):
        out += f"{offsets[i]:010d} 00000 n \n".encode()
    out += f"trailer\n<< /Size {count} /Root 1 0 R >>\nstartxref\n{xref_pos}\n%%EOF\n".encode()

    path.write_bytes(bytes(out))

output_path = cwd / "report_with_cover.pdf"
